Management Plan

- Clearly summarize key management actions, treatments, and recommendations provided:
  - Clinical impression: suspected gastroenteritis (t tummy bug).
  - Advise increased fluid intake to prevent dehydration.
  - Recommend Dioralyte (oral rehydration solution) to replenish fluids and electrolytes.
  - Paracetamol can be used for fever/weakness.
  - Recommend continuing home rest and avoid returning to work until diarrhea-free for 24–48 hours; anticipate return in 1–2 days, with follow-up if not improved.
  - If symptoms persist or worsen, advised to return for re-evaluation next week.

- Mention any immediate interventions, follow-up appointments, or patient education:
  - Education on hydration and use of oral rehydration solution.
  - Return visit if not improving next week; otherwise expect self-resolution within typical 3–5 days.
  - No additional medications or tests prescribed at this visit.
